S44 predicted the breach in writing; S45 breached anyway and installed the two-state rule as the remedy; S46 read the rule and breached anyway. 🔑 THE REMEDY FAILED FOR A NAMEABLE REASON: the two-state rule tells you what to do AFTER you measure, and NOTHING FORCES A MEASUREMENT BEFORE THE APPEND. A rule that only binds at the moment you happen to look is not a control (ML-RED-246, ML-RED-257). THE FIX IS A PRE-APPEND SIZE GATE IN THE WRITE PATH, not a shorter-rows resolution and not a fourth banner.
